title: Sunburst necklace: Rhino to render in one click

post.youtube_title: Sunburst necklace: Rhino to render in one click
post.caption:
A sunburst necklace, rendered from Rhino with the free HeyGema plug-in: press HeyGema on the toolbar, pick the metal and render.

Install it in Rhino: type PackageManager, search heygema and click Install.
How it works: https://www.heygema.com/en/rhino?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=shorts&utm_campaign=yt-rhino-sunburst-necklace

Sunburst necklace model: "Necklace b" by shah_max (sketchfab.com/shah_max), CC BY 4.0.
